name: browser-research
description: Research public web pages through the Browser Research Chrome extension.

interface.shortDescription: Research the web through your Chrome extension.
interface.longDescription: Browser Research adds read-only MCP tools for autonomous discovery and page extraction through the paired Browser Research Chrome extension. The local broker starts with the plugin and pairs once without exposing browser cookies or a long-lived credential.
defaultPrompt: Research this topic with Browser Research and cite the final source URLs.
